sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A mysterious metamorphic sorcerer who sought the title of the strongest warrior. Many believe Ne-Kau hails from a different world due to his eccentric appearance. A master of magic, friend to the weak, and champion against evil, rumor had it that he resembled a god of war. Although he proved himself as a worthy adversary against many, off the battlefield he was quite polite and respectful. However, the moment he joined the fray he displayed such raw strength and power that he was often mistaken for a demon.

Many believe Ne-Kau hails from a different world due to his eccentric appearance. A master of magic, friend to the weak, and champion against evil, rumor had it that he resembled a god of war. Although he proved himself as a worthy adversary against many, off the battlefield he was quite polite and respectful.
